author: ImRaging
body:
This map was made by Eric, i have nothing to do with it. He cannot make posts for some reason so i am posting it for him.


Name: Xena [TE]
Gamemode: TDM
PPT: 8v8 max, will be an edition for megascrims with like 10v10 if will be requested.
Teams: Yellow vs. Green

The map includes many cool features that past maps didn't have, like spawners, cover to upgrade bow gameplay, floating lava for fire shots, interesting gameplay, 1 Scorebox per team, 2 spawns per team and more you can see in screenshots.

Images: http://imgur.com/a/Oo3go
Download will be sent to officials via skype.
YML will be done as soon as scoreboxes get added. (which is soon, wink wink)

Feedback is welcome
